items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Another uncle taught me to play the flute as a hobby. His name was Victor Guerra.

ctx.x: His name was Jacinto Guerra, the brother of my mother. Another uncle taught me to play the flute as a hobby. His name was Victor Guerra. Regarding the flute, a curious thing, my uncle had one as he was a professional musician, so he had a professional flute and played with an orchestra - a charanga, what was called a charanga. Then . . .
Do you remember exactly which one?
